title: Nainital Tour Package
bestFor: Couples, Families, Friends & First-Time Hill Travellers
overview: Planning a quick hill trip without burning a hole in your pocket? Safar Trails has you covered. This Nainital tour package is 3 days and 2 nights at ₹7,999 per person, with hotel stay and private cab both included. No running around for bookings, no last-minute tension — pack your bags and we handle the rest. Two nights in a comfortable hotel with breakfast, a private cab for your pickup, drop and all sightseeing, every applicable tax already in the price, and a support team on the phone for the whole trip.
highlights: Kainchi Dham — darshan at the Neem Karoli Baba ashram outside town
Mall Road — evening chai, shopping and Naini Lake views
Naini Lake boating — the shikara ride the town is named for
Naina Devi Temple — on the northern shore of the lake
Ropeway to Snow View Point — the Himalayan skyline on a clear day
Eco Cave Gardens — a short, easy stop the kids tend to enjoy most
Tiffin Top — the viewpoint above the town, reached by cab or pony
inclusions: 2 nights' hotel stay with daily breakfast
Private cab for pickup, drop and all sightseeing
Safar Trails support team available throughout your trip
exclusions: Entry tickets — boating, ropeway and similar activities

itinerary.title: Reach Nainital
itinerary.description: Arrive in Nainital and check in at the hotel. Freshen up, then head straight to Mall Road for evening chai, some shopping and the lake views it is known for. A simple, relaxed start to the trip.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Mall Road — chai, shopping and Naini Lake views

itinerary.title: Sightseeing Day
itinerary.description: A full day out with your cab: Naini Lake boating, Naina Devi Temple, the ropeway to Snow View Point, Eco Cave Gardens and Tiffin Top. The evening is free — do what you like. Boating and ropeway tickets are paid at the gate.
itinerary.morningActivity: Naini Lake boating and Naina Devi Temple
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Ropeway to Snow View Point, Eco Cave Gardens and Tiffin Top
itinerary.eveningActivity: Free — Mall Road, a café, or an early night

itinerary.title: Kainchi Dham & Head Back Home
itinerary.description: Breakfast and hotel check-out, then out to Kainchi Dham — the Neem Karoli Baba ashram — for darshan before your onward drop. Go early if you can: it fills up as the morning goes on. Home with a phone full of photos and a mind full of good memories.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check-out and drive to Kainchi Dham
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Darshan at Kainchi Dham, then the departure drop

season: March to June & September to November

faqs.question: What exactly does ₹7,999 per person cover?
faqs.answer: Two nights' hotel stay with daily breakfast, a private cab for your pickup, drop and all sightseeing, and every applicable tax. Lunch and dinner, entry tickets for boating and the ropeway, and personal shopping are not included.

faqs.question: Is travel from my city to Nainital included?
faqs.answer: The cab covers your pickup, drop and sightseeing for this trip. If you also need transport from Delhi, Kathgodam or anywhere else, tell us where you are starting from and we will add it to your quote before you pay anything.

faqs.question: Is Kainchi Dham included in this Nainital package?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kainchi Dham is on day 3 — breakfast, check-out, and then out to the Neem Karoli Baba ashram for darshan before your onward drop. The drive is covered by the same private cab, at no extra cost. It gets busy as the morning goes on, so an early start is worth it.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be changed?
faqs.answer: Yes. The three days above are what most people want on a first Nainital trip, but the hotel category, the sightseeing list and the number of nights can all be adjusted. Tell us what you would rather do.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for families with children or elderly parents?
faqs.answer: Yes. The sightseeing is spread across one relaxed day, the drives are short, and the ropeway means Snow View Point needs no climbing. Tiffin Top can be reached by cab if a pony ride is not wanted.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Nainital?
faqs.answer: March to June is the main season, when the plains are hot and the lake town is not. September to November is quieter, clearer and better for the Himalayan views from Snow View Point. December to February is cold, and snow is possible but never guaranteed.

faqs.question: Is the price the final amount?
faqs.answer: The ₹7,999 is per person on the stated inclusions, and all applicable taxes are already in it. Anything you add — a better hotel, extra nights, transport from your city — is quoted before you confirm. What we quote is what you pay.
